_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Ti xe Player {player_id}, xogando {num_rounds} torni de Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Ti ghè ${pool} da spartir sta rota tra te e Player {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Fà na oferta: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Se acetà → Ti te ciapi $(pool - X), l'altro xogador ciapa $X
  - Se refudà → Tutti do i ciapa $0
  - Esempio: [Offer: $3]  o  'Me par che sta roba qua sia giusta. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Decidi su l'oferta co [Accept] o [Reject]
  - Esempio: 'Me par che sta roba qua sia razonèvol. [Accept]'
            'Troppo ingiusto. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Rota {round_number} scumìsia! ---
Player {proposer_id} xe el proposer, Player {responder_id} xe el responder.
round.accepted: Player {responder_id} ga acetà! Rota {round_number} guadagni: Player {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Player {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Novi totali: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} ga refudà l'oferta! Rota {round_number} guadagni: Tutti do i xogadori +$0. Totali resti: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: El proponente el ga da far un'oferta doparando el formato [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: L'importo de l'oferta el ga da esar un numero intiero vałido.
invalid_move.out_of_range: L'oferta ła ga da esar tra $0 e ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: No ghe xe offerte atuali da risponder.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: El rispondiente el ga da [Accept] o [Reject] l'oferta.

outcome.win: Player {winner} ga vinto co ${winner_total} in totale vs Player {loser} co ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Pareghi!Tuti i do ga finìo co ${total} in total.
